sections.content:
# Profile and Identity: Hor Tongan

## Identity and Background
- Name: Hor Tongan (Hor is family name, Tongan is given name)
- Age: 20 years old
- Hometown: Tboung Khmum Province, Cambodia
- Current Residence: Phnom Penh, Cambodia (attending university)
- Hometown Life: Misses Tboung Khmum for the peaceful vibe, clean air, and stargazing at night. Light pollution in Phnom Penh makes stargazing rare now.
- Education: Third-year IT student at The University of Cambodia (scholarship recipient).
- Family and Friends: Close family (father, mother, sister). Best friend is Bunghy.

## Communication and Work Habits
- Language: Prefers English for almost all written notes, code, documentation, and chat. Speaks Khmer natively.
- Leadership Style: Highly proactive and values constructive feedback. Strongly dislikes passive silence in team projects.
- Sleep: Night owl (sleeps 1:00 AM to 4:00 AM).
- Workstations: Windows on desktop PC for daily tasks. CachyOS (optimized Arch Linux) on slow laptop for speed.
- Coding Environment: Prefers complete silence when coding. No background music.
- Tooling: VS Code (minimal extensions), Android Studio, Godot 4.7, native Git CLI, Bash, CMake.
- Learning Approach: Learn by building real projects rather than watching tutorials.

## Engineering Philosophy
- Anti-Overengineering: Radical simplicity. Minimal code, minimal bloat, semantic structure, zero unnecessary frameworks.
- Offline-First: Lives in a rented room in Phnom Penh with unreliable Wi-Fi, relying on mobile hotspot. Designs apps to work 100% offline without mandatory internet.
- Favorite Language: Java (strict OOP structure, predictable, straightforward English keywords).
- Career Motivation: Pragmatic and driven to achieve financial security through professional software engineering.

## Contact
- Website: https://tongan.dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/tonganwashere
- Telegram: @tonganwashere (https://t.me/tonganwashere)

sections.title: projects
sections.content:
# Projects: Technical Summary

## 1. Genera (October 2026)
- Type: Offline-first flashcard web app
- Status: Finished, Live at https://genera-bvzb.onrender.com/
- GitHub: https://github.com/tonganwashere/genera
- Role: Solo developer (~1 month)
- Tech Stack: Python, Flask, vanilla JavaScript, SQLite, IndexedDB, Service Worker, Resend API
- Overview: Structured trivia flashcard app with ~4,500 questions across 24 categories from Open Trivia DB. Supports custom decks and CSV/JSON import/export.
- Core Engine: 5-box Leitner spaced repetition system (1, 2, 4, 8, 16 day intervals).
- Offline Architecture: Service Worker caches app shell; IndexedDB stores cards locally. Zero login required to study.
- Sync: Last-Write-Wins timestamp conflict resolution with Flask/SQLite backend on Render. Account merging preserves offline progress.

## 2. Proctor (September - October 2026)
- Type: Terminal examination and quiz management platform
- Status: Finished
- GitHub: https://github.com/tonganwashere/proctor
- Role: Solo developer for architecture, database, and AI (~2 months)
- Tech Stack: Java, Terminal UI, PostgreSQL, Ollama (Llama 3.2 local LLM), MVC Architecture
- Features: Teacher role (author questions, build quizzes/exams) and student role (timed tests, immediate scoring).
- Local AI: Ollama integration for generating questions and grading open-ended answers.
- Database: PostgreSQL with automated startup schema validation and migrations.

## 3. PyDFile (July - August 2026)
- Type: Offline desktop PDF management suite
- Status: Finished, Standalone Windows Executable v1.0.0
- GitHub: https://github.com/tonganwashere/pydfile
- Download: https://github.com/tonganwashere/pydfile/releases/tag/v1.0.0
- Role: Solo developer (~2 months)
- Tech Stack: Python, CustomTkinter, PyMuPDF, pikepdf, PyInstaller
- Philosophy: 100% local privacy. Completely offline with zero telemetry or network calls.
- Tools: Merge, split, reorder, compress, watermark, page numbering, password protect, unlock, image conversion, text extraction. Packaged into a single Windows .exe.

## 4. Pitch Flip (May - June 2026)
- Type: Android 3D coin flip application
- Status: Finished, Play Store release planned
- GitHub: https://github.com/tonganwashere/pitch_flip
- Role: Solo developer (~2 months). First Android app and first OpenGL project.
- Tech Stack: Kotlin, Android SDK, OpenGL ES 2.0
- Features: Realistic 3D coin rendering with custom GLSL shaders and flip speed slider.
- Secret Rig: Hidden trick mode ties coin landing (heads vs tails) to hardware volume level without on-screen clues.
- Reflection: Hardest project built so far due to OpenGL shader pipeline and 3D matrix math.

## 5. Wordle++ (March - April 2026)
- Type: Terminal word guessing game
- Status: Finished
- GitHub: https://github.com/tonganwashere/wordle_plus_plus
- Role: Solo developer (~2 months). Won Top 1 project in ISTAD Pre-University Course.
- Tech Stack: C++, FTXUI, nlohmann/json, CMake
- Features: Rich terminal UI with color-coded hints, 4 game modes (3-letter, 5-letter, 6-letter, Daily Challenge), player streaks, and admin dashboard (admin/admin123) for managing word banks.

## 6. Bread and Blades: Pixel Duel RPG (In Development)
- Type: 2D pixel-art 1v1 melee fighting RPG for Android and PC
- Tech Stack: Godot 4.7, GDScript, custom Q8 fixed-point integer AABB physics
- Highlights: Tournament story mode where no characters die on screen (kneel rule). Deterministic integer math from day one for cross-platform physics parity. 7 melee weapons, no pay-to-win.

## 7. Other Projects
- PixelArt BLE Canvas: Interactive 16x16 LED matrix canvas over Bluetooth Low Energy (ESP32, Web Bluetooth).
- NEXA: Community forum and lost-and-found platform (ISTAD Foundation capstone, Top 1 team).
- tongan.dev: Semantic portfolio built with vanilla HTML, Tailwind, and JS on GitHub Pages.

sections.content:
# Education and Experience

## Education History
- The University of Cambodia: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (Third Year, Dec 2024 - Present). Scholarship student.
- ISTAD Foundation Course: Java, PostgreSQL, React, Git workflows (May - Oct 2026). Top 3 student individually, Top 1 team capstone for NEXA.
- ISTAD Pre-University Course: C++, OOP, data structures, terminal development (Jan - Mar 2026). Top 3 student individually, Top 1 project for Wordle++.
- Samdach Techo Hunsen Suong High School: High School Diploma (BacII passed Oct 2024).

## Work Experience
- Librarian and IT Support at The University of Cambodia (Aug - Nov 2025): Maintained computer lab workstations, hardware repairs, networking, and user support.
- Personal Assistant and Digital Content Assistant, Remote (Nov 2024 - Apr 2025): Research, content drafting, workflow organization.
- English Teacher at First Bridge International School (Jul 2023 - Jul 2024): Taught conversational English and grammar to middle school students.

sections.title: hobbies
sections.content:
# Hobbies and Personal Life

## Gaming
- Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB): Peak rank Mythical Glory, currently Mythic. Main hero is Julian played with high aggression (EXP Lane and Jungle). Pocket picks: Barats, Guinevere, Gloo, Ruby.
- Other Games: Childhood love for Minecraft (ran a small Minecraft PE YouTube channel with ~50 subs). Loves roguelikes: The Binding of Isaac, Slay the Spire.

## Anime and Manga
- Preferences: Watches anime strictly in Japanese with English subtitles (SUB only, never dub).
- Favorite Anime: Steins;Gate, Vinland Saga, Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Attack on Titan, Naruto.
- Favorite Manga: Great Teacher Onizuka (GTO), All You Need Is Kill, Saikyou Densetsu Kurosawa.
- Admired Characters: Eikichi Onizuka (kindness and loyalty), Thorfinn (peace and maturity).

## Food and Pets
- Food: Comfort food is burgers. Can cook Khmer stir-fries, cannot cook soup. Bucket list food is authentic Japanese ramen.
- Cats: Peanut (chubby, friendly orange cat with short legs) and Milo (feisty, 3-colored calico girl who bites but is a great hunter).
- Outdoors: Enjoys stargazing in rural areas and taking solo walks to think through software problems.
